episodes.title: Countdown
episodes.summary: Unsettling events put a group of brilliant friends on edge as a mystery unravels with origins tracing back to China during the Cultural Revolution.

episodes.title: Red Coast
episodes.summary: Auggie's countdown jeopardizes her nanotech work. Jin becomes engrossed in an otherworldly VR game. Ye Wenjie follows through on a radical idea.

episodes.title: Destroyer of Worlds
episodes.summary: Obsessed with their virtual reality quest, Jin and Jack race to solve a complex riddle — but advancing to the next level brings harrowing consequences.

episodes.title: Our Lord
episodes.summary: Jin seeks justice after a death rattles the group. Investigators learn of an extremist group devoted to an otherworldly entity ahead of a major summit.

episodes.title: Judgment Day
episodes.summary: As threat levels rise, a secret mission to retrieve enemy intel ventures into dangerous territory. An ominous message reaches Earth.

episodes.title: The Stars Our Destination
episodes.summary: With the world in a state of panic following a momentous declaration, Wade gathers the world's greatest minds to prepare a defense plan.

episodes.title: Only Advance
episodes.summary: A bold proposition for the Staircase Project puts the group at odds. Will weighs his options. Ye returns to a familiar place.

episodes.title: Wallfacer
episodes.summary: A high-level operation upends Saul's life. With emotions and expectations high, the probe launches into space as humanity enters a daunting new era.
